name: WeP Solutions Limited
about: WeP Solutions Limited provides managed printing solutions and digital services in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Partners Business and Enterprise Business. It manufactures and distributes retail billing products that include handheld billing machines and desktop billing printers; and multifunctional printers. The company offers HOOK's POS, a single point of sale system for modern retail and FnB operations; consumables and spares, including toner and ink cartridges, ribbons, and paper rolls; digital services, such as software for filing GST returns; and infrastructure managed services. It also provides fluidWorks services suite, such as fluidPro, an automation-led service that helps to modernize and manage IT infrastructure; fluidPrint, offers managed print services; fluidMap, a solution that enables IT asset tracking and management; and fluidTrail, a solution that offers workflow automation and document management services. In addition, the company offers employee on-boarding and records management solutions; procure to pay automation solutions; enterprise documents management software; and floTax, a GST and e-invoicing solutions that include GST returns filing, reconciliation, and e-way bill. Further, it distributes Fujifilm and Ricoh products and solutions which includes office automation printers, devices, and copiers, as well as trades in multifunctional printers. The company serves enterprise and retail customers. WeP Solutions Limited was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
